idea: Agri-technology adoption advisory for Italian producers
pain: Technology could improve yields and margins but nobody helps them choose
v1: A technology assessment for one producer
verdict: Warm access to a buyer with thin margins and little history of paying consultants.

why.distribution: Directly reachable through her husband's network, but a small, geographically concentrated set.
why.demand: Inferred; Italian producers rarely buy consultancy and margins are thin.
why.fmf: Technology evaluation transfers from her AI work, but agriculture is a domain she does not know.
why.defensibility: Agricultural consultants and equipment dealers hold these relationships.
why.time_to_revenue: 6-9 months to learn the domain and build trust.
why.tailwind: Agri-tech and EU subsidy programmes are genuinely pushing adoption.
why.ceiling: £9k x 22 producers = £198k, far beyond what this buyer will spend.

ceiling_arithmetic: £9k x 22 producers = £198k. Italian producers of this size rarely spend £9k on advice; realistic is 3-5 = £27-45k, and probably less.
carries: Warm access and a genuine EU-subsidised adoption push.
kills: The buyer does not buy consultancy, and she does not know agriculture.
test: Ask five producers what they spent on outside advice last year.
test_fail: They rely on their equipment dealer and cooperative.
